content.heading: European Vehicle Specialists for Mini
content.leadText: Mini is part of the BMW Group, and modern Minis share the same engineering standards and advanced materials as their larger siblings. At Eurotech, we bring our BMW Group accreditation and 20+ years of European vehicle expertise to every Mini repair.

sections.title: Repair Done Right
paragraphs: Whether it's a Hatchback, Countryman, Clubman, or Convertible, we follow the manufacturer's prescribed repair procedures for every Mini model. Our technicians are trained in the specific techniques required for Mini's construction methods.
We use genuine parts and the Glasurit 100 Line paint system to ensure colour accuracy and a factory-quality finish. Every repair is backed by a written guarantee.

sections.title: Full Insurance Support
paragraphs: We work with all major New Zealand insurance companies and handle the entire claims process on your behalf — from initial assessment and quoting through to final inspection and delivery.
Our experience with European vehicles means we know how to work within insurer requirements while maintaining the repair quality your Mini deserves. No shortcuts, no compromises.
